title: ぼくのなつやすみ
title_romaji: Boku no Natsuyasumi: Summer Holiday 20th Century
sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 63 characters of prose-like text
Genkan memory search during play: system messages in Shift-JIS, dialogue not

Table read by eye from the game's font (in BOKU.BIN, and in video memory during play in a headless replay), then proofread against the dialogue in BOKU.BIN and the menu texts in the executable, which are stored as these codes
notes: Dialogue, lists and menu texts are 16-bit codes numbering the glyphs of the game's own font; the table has all but six of them. 0x8000 ends a text, 0x8001 is a new line, 0x8002 ends a page and is followed by one more word (a time, not text) that a reader has to skip. Kanji found in a sentence were proofread there; about 95 of the 1,202 are in no text found and are read from the glyph alone. The layout reads the dialogue panel's page; menus, lists and the few Shift-JIS system messages are not covered.
